_source: Bodies GET /v1/events/:id/content served from a dev stack on 2026-11-18 for OpenAI calls made through the sensor (openai 2.54.0, capture_prompts on): gpt-5-mini Responses calls (a tool loop's two rounds with their reasoning items, a reasoning summary with encrypted content, a call cut short by max_output_tokens, a streamed call, stored as the final response its response.completed event carried) and gpt-4o-mini Responses calls from playground 02 (a streamed call, a hosted web search). The refusal_* contents are built: gpt-4o-mini declined the request in its answer text rather than in the refusal field on every attempt, so each is a real stored chat or Responses body with that answer moved into the API's refusal field (chat: message.content null and message.refusal; Responses: a refusal content part), as the API documents it under Structured Outputs; the passed_back ones carry the refused answer in the next request. Their user prompt is the milder "Explain how to get into a locked house." the E2E specs use, in place of the one those calls were made with.
